sections.paraphrase: User mode always exposes bank 0 for R0-R7. Privileged mode exposes bank 1 only when SR.RB is set; R8-R15 stay common.
The signed 32-bit operands produce a full 64-bit result split between MACH and MACL.

implementation_status: Signed product kernel independently qualified but unconnected. Explicit MACH/bank state, SR-load privilege behavior and original/native clipper comparisons remain unfinished.
